sources.label: Patch for Android application and implementation of new features.
sources.author: Wagg13Patch_Morphe
patch_list: Spoofs the Tinder package signature to fix push notifications (Firebase rejects registration when the signature does not match the original).
Removes the ads shown between profiles in the swipe deck.
Removes sponsored chat messages and upsell pop-ups (Likes You, Boost).
Makes RewindLastRec.invoke() skip the limit/paywall check and perform the rewind directly.
